summary: Gorax announces he is starting a fresh account on the newly launched Celebration server starting on September 15th. The Celebration server is aimed at new and returning players, offering anniversary rewards, Heliolite Dice, and progression gifts. He plans to make beginner-friendly guides for dungeons, Continental Challenge bosses, and endgame content using new heroes on early content. Additionally, the game has introduced Spanish language support.
meta_changes: Celebration Server opening on September 15 for new and returning players with exclusive events and progression packs.
Spanish language support added to the game.
tips: New or returning players looking to start fresh should join the Celebration server to take advantage of anniversary rewards and Journey Support gifts.
title: I'm Starting a FRESH Account for DragonHeir's 3rd Anniversary! | DragonHeir x Dragonstride
